gcp.appengine.service_version_count.summary: Bring the App Engine service within its owner-approved installed and serving version limits.
steps: Confirm the project-bound approved installed and SERVING maxima with the service owner, and inspect which versions currently serve traffic or are needed for rollback.
For a serving count over its limit, shift traffic and stop reviewed older versions only after confirming the desired active release and rollback plan.

For an installed count over its limit, remove a version only after the owner confirms it is no longer needed and its code and rollback requirements are covered elsewhere; then verify the version inventory again.
caveats: Stopping or deleting a version can disrupt traffic or rollback. The check does not prove which version is safe to stop or delete.
Missing or incomplete inventories and absent owner maxima remain UNKNOWN.

references.title: App Engine Version resource and serving status
